summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for NDA021977 (Vyvanse / lisdexamfetamine). The Medical Review states explicitly under section 8.5 (Advisory Committee Meeting) that the submission was not presented to the Psychopharmacologic Drugs Advisory Committee, and the Administrative Correspondence checklist lists the Advisory Committee Meeting Date of Meeting as N/A. Because no committee was held, there are no AdComm-driven concerns or resulting changes to link to the approval.
